text: Who are the best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Melbourne? Give me a shortlist of reputable Power Platform consulting partners with reasons.

result.keyword: Who are the best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Melbourne? Give me a shortlist of reputable Power Platform consulting partners with reasons.

items.markdown:
Here is a shortlist of reputable Microsoft Power Platform consulting and implementation partners in Melbourne, `known for their deep technical credentials, enterprise experience, and integration capabilities across the Microsoft ecosystem`.

- [Engage Squared](https://engagesq.com/what-we-do/technologies/power-platform/) 
	- **Core Focus:** Enterprise Power Apps, digitising paper-based workflows, and human-centric adoption.
	- **Why They Stand Out:** They are a preferred Microsoft partner for Business Applications and hold an advanced specialisation in Change Management. They excel at ensuring end-user adoption and turning out-of-the-box Power Platform components into smooth solutions that integrate cleanly with Microsoft Teams and SharePoint.[[1]](https://engagesq.com/what-we-do/technologies/power-platform/)
- [Professional Advantage](https://www.pa.com.au/products/microsoft-power-platform/) 
	- **Core Focus:** Business process automation, Dynamics 365 integration, and Power BI reporting.
	- **Why They Stand Out:** With decades of Australian consulting heritage, their team bridges the gap between complex enterprise systems and practical low-code execution. They are particularly strong if you need your Power Apps and Power Automate workflows tightly bound to ERP, CRM, or financial systems.[[1]](https://www.pa.com.au/products/microsoft-power-platform/)
- [Velrada](https://velrada.com/) 
	- **Core Focus:** Intelligent automation, low-code applications, field service solutions, and enterprise data platforms.
	- **Why They Stand Out:** A global Microsoft Cloud Solution Partner with a strong local Australian footprint, Velrada builds purpose-engineered products on top of the stack (such as smart rostering and asset management solutions) alongside bespoke enterprise Power Platform architectures.[[1]](https://velrada.com/)
- [Avanade](https://www.avanade.com/en-au/services/microsoft-tech/microsoft-power-platform) 
	- **Core Focus:** Fusion development (low-code + pro-code), advanced AI integration via Copilot Studio, and process mining.
	- **Why They Stand Out:** Backed by Accenture and Microsoft, Avanade is a tier-1 global choice for large-scale transformations. They are exceptional if your strategy involves scaling citizen development governance safely or deploying cutting-edge Agentic AI and Copilot extensions within the Power Platform.[[1]](https://www.avanade.com/en-au/services/microsoft-tech/microsoft-power-platform)

If you'd like to narrow down this list, tell me:

- What is your **primary goal** (e.g., building custom Power Apps, automating workflows with Power Automate, or enterprise analytics/Copilot)?
- What is the **scale** of your organisation (SME vs. large enterprise)?

I can help you **determine which partner best matches your specific project scope**.
